title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → Program
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Program rules. Degree, college, major requirements, CIP code, total hours required. One row per program per effective term.
Curriculum rules. Defines curriculum (program + major + concentration + minor combinations). Links program to specific majors.
Major validation. Major codes and descriptions (used for both majors and minors).
College validation. College codes and descriptions (e.g., 'AS' = Arts & Sciences, 'EN' = Engineering).
Degree code validation. Degree designations (BS, BA, MS, PhD, etc.).
Class validation. Classification codes (FR, SO, JR, SR).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + SMRPRLE_PROGRAM + STVMAJR_CODE (for the primary major).
Resolve major code description. e.g., 'Computer Science'.
Map Banner level: 'UG'→'bachelors' (or 'associate'), 'GR'→'masters', 'DR'→'doctoral'. Refine using degree code.
Map: if SOBCURR_MAJR_CODE_1 populated → 'major'; if minor code populated → 'minor'; if concentration → 'concentration'.
Direct map. CIP code for IPEDS reporting.
Resolve college code to HELIX AcademicOrg.helix_id.
Direct map. Total hours required for degree completion.

attribute_mappings.source: SMRPRLE.SMRPRLE_CRSE_STATUS_IND or derived from effective term
